text:
simon_pm: Quick sync — putting docs/support/monitoring/pricing up for final GA signoff on the new Edge-Optimized offering. Need owners and any outstanding risks by EOD tomorrow. TL;DR: SLA targets, pricing tiers, runbook, dashboards.

maya_eng: thanks. can we confirm the SLOs again? earlier we talked 50ms p50 and 150ms p95 for small payloads. is that still the bar?

eric_finops: pricing question — do we want a single premium tier or tiered (reserved vs burst)? customers asked for an hourly reserved option.

ashley_docs: doc deadline: I can finish the user-facing guide and quickstart by Tue if we lock the API shape and examples now. who owns the migration notes?

olga_sre: monitoring/runbook checklist from my side: 1) latency p50/p95, 2) request success rate, 3) queue length/backpressure, 4) GPU utilization by pool, 5) cold-start counts. runbook needs: paging thresholds + rollback play.

onthread_note (deploy-bot): CI: integration-tests/edge-mode passed on branch feature/edge-ga (build #492).

maya_eng: confirmed on SLOs — 50/150 for 1KB requests. add a 300ms p99 guardrail for burst windows.

eric_finops: proposal: two billing lanes — Reserved (monthly commit, lower per-token), and OnDemandBurst (per-second billing with burst cap). add an activation fee for tiny pilot orgs? could be a discount instead.

ashley_docs: migration notes: @simon_pm who should I CC? ops and sales? also need sample SLA language for the docs.

olga_sre: runbook snippet suggestion (short):
```
- If p95 latency > 200ms for >5m: alert paging:oncall-sre
- If request success rate < 99% for >3m: trigger incident commander
- If GPU pool utilization > 85% and queue length growing: scale-policy: emergency-burst
```

onthread_note (oncall-bot): Reminder: paging rota for Edge GA will start 2026-05-01.

simon_pm: Owners: SLA wording + contracts -> eric_finops, Docs + examples -> ashley_docs, Monitoring + runbooks -> olga_sre, Infra scaling + autoscale policy -> maya_eng. Action items:
- eric_finops: draft SLA language + pricing lanes, attach sample T&Cs (due 48h)
- ashley_docs: user guide + migration notes + SLA snippet (due Tue COB)
- olga_sre: dashboard widgets + runbook + escalation matrix (due 48h)
- maya_eng: validate autoscale policy and cold-start mitigations (due 48h)

simon_pm: final checklist to sign GA: [SLA agreed, Docs published, Runbooks in handbook, Monitoring dashboards live, Buyflow & pricing validated, Oncall rota scheduled]. we should have a brief shiproom sync Thurs AM to greenlight.

maya_eng: small risk: burst tests showed queuing at 10k qps for models with long decode. I'll run a targeted load with prefix-caching enabled and report back.

eric_finops: ok on draft SLA. thinking to include explicit failure credits tied to p95 latency and success rate. will send proposal.

ashley_docs: ack. I'll draft the SLA paragraph like: "Redwood Edge-Optimized will maintain p95 latency <= 150ms for 1KB requests. Failure to meet targets results in service credits per contract." will send PR to docs repo.

olga_sre: quick ask: can we get access to the production metrics stream for dashboards? @maya_eng can you grant?

maya_eng: granting read access to olga_sre now.

simon_pm: cool. if no blockers by EOD tomorrow, I'll schedule shiproom Thurs 09:30 PT. react with :thumbsup: if you can make it.

eric_finops: :thumbsup:

ashley_docs: :thumbsup:

maya_eng: :thumbsup:

olga_sre: :thumbsup:

onthread_note (deploy-bot): Note: canary rollout plan uploaded to /deployments/edge-ga/canary-plan.md

simon_pm: thanks team — we need focused updates in the thread only. will summarize owners + deadlines after each deliverable posts.
